assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Fails when fewer than two ISN declarations are found in pyproject.toml, so the walker cannot pass vacuously by finding nothing.
Fails when an ISN declaration carries a URL or not exactly one version specifier.
Fails when a specifier is not == or is a wildcard such as ==0.10.*.
Fails when the ISN declarations name different versions; pin-negative-control.log shows this assertion red at EXIT=1.

findings.text: follow-on: the added test asserts only that the two pyproject.toml ISN pins agree with each other, while the defect this node repaired was a divergence between the pyproject pin (0.10.0) and the installed package metadata (0.9.3) that grammar_sync.py:288 reads via imas_standard_names.__version__; no assertion imports the package, so a recurrence of the version-drift class leaves the suite green.
